decisions.reason: As an incremental component tied to the installed radiant-heater business, it is cheap to carry and there is not yet enough negative evidence after one year to justify withdrawal.
As a flagship electric line with several models that fits the firm's electrification path, its option value is high and the firm is unlikely to abandon it so early.
This halogen variant is less central and may overlap with other electric infrared offers, but after a short market life the firm would likely keep it while demand uncertainty resolves.
A multi-model industrial hall heater is close to core customers and applications, so a growing HVAC machinery firm would usually continue backing it absent clear failure.

The hydrogen-capable line is strategically important, already piloted in real operation, and under real-options logic the firm would preserve this high-upside decarbonization option despite uncertainty.
